Kent County.label: Delaware Department of Elections, filed candidates for the 11/03/2026 statewide general election
Kent County.intro: The Delaware Department of Elections filed-candidate list for the 11/03/2026 statewide general election, last updated 2026-10-15 07:56 PM, names these offices for Kent County.
Kent County.note: Only rows whose Status column prints Qualified are copied. The list also names county council districts and levy court districts, which are not copied. The candidate-list index says filed candidates appear on the General Election list unless and until a Primary Election is created by a subsequent candidate from the same political party filing for the same office.
